Name: Iridium Tools Patch
Author: ToweringRedwood
Description:
[u]Makes the iridium farming tools (Hoe and Watering Can) cover a 5x5 area at maximum charge, matching the coverage of iridium sprinklers.[/u]

The mod includes an editable config.json file if you'd like to edit the range further. The "length" variable counts how many tiles out from the farmer will be affected. The "radius" variable counts how many tiles out from either side of the middle length will be affected. See the images for reference.

[size=4]Installing & Usage:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Make sure SMAPI is installed (Probably a good idea to use the latest version, 2.7 as of writing this)[/size]
[*][size=2]Download this mod from the files tab and unzip it into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=2]Any Irdium farm tools you use will have their maximum ranges changed to 5x5 automatically![/size]
[*][size=2]Change the max range using the 'config.json' file in the main mod folder (changes won't take effect until the next time you start SDV).[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Compatability:[/size]
[list]
[*]Works on Windows 10, SDV version 1.3. I haven't tested it on Mac, Linux, or Ubuntu so let me know if it isn't working for you on one of those OS' and I'll mess around with the build settings.
[*]As for compatability with other mods that modify input and game mechanics, it works with: [i]Better Artisan Good Icons, Prismatic Tools, [/i]and [i]Rotate Toolbar[/i]. Haven't tested it further, so let me know if you're having issues and I'll do my best to address them!
[/list]
[size=4]Source Code:[/size]
[size=2][url=https://github.com/EKomperud/StardewMods]On Github[/url]. Message me if you're curious about anything in the code. I'm happy to help out![/size]
